title: Groundwater-only equal-dimension placement discriminator after purpose-specific Reference qualification
rationale: Global P1 stopped because the surface Reference gate failed. The GW Reference route independently qualified for B01 and B14 before any Layer-ROM candidate response. ROM-PURPOSE is purpose-specific, so GW may proceed only under a new explicit authority that preserves all frozen GW scientific choices.
backend_policy: Use the P1 frozen backend for comparability with the qualified Reference. Do not silently rebase the scientific experiment onto later canonical.

reference_gate.purpose_local_authority: P1G explicitly authorizes only GW_LB candidate generation after its own execution binding.

workload: Exact frozen P1 GW_LB histories G01-G04 and boundary forcing; no change.
metrics: Exact frozen P1 GW_LB component vector; no weighted score and materials remain separate.

hypotheses.H1G: For each qualified material, G4 is componentwise no worse than U4 on the frozen GW vector and strictly better on at least one component.
hypotheses.H3G: At least one GW material shows strict equal-dimensional information value for purpose-aligned placement.
hypotheses.H4G: If G4 does not cross the frozen R512_T32 comparator, execute only the preregistered same-partition G4 CoRichards diagnostic before assigning the deficit to propagation/closure.

decision_rules.PLACEMENT_SUPPORTED: G4 <= U4 on every frozen GW metric within the inherited 1e-12 componentwise equality tolerance, with at least one strict improvement.
decision_rules.UNIFORM_NONINFERIOR: U4 <= G4 on every frozen GW metric, with at least one strict improvement.
decision_rules.PLACEMENT_MIXED: Neither G4 nor U4 is componentwise noninferior.
decision_rules.H4_TRIGGER: G4 is qualified as a candidate but does not cross the frozen R512_T32 numerical comparator.
